info.title: Crypto Address Validator
info.description: Crypto Address Validator checks and classifies crypto wallet addresses across ten chains with zero dependencies: from-scratch Base58Check (double-SHA256), full Bech32/Bech32m segwit decoding (BIP-173 / BIP-350, P2WPKH / P2WSH / P2TR), Ethereum EIP-55 Keccak-256 checksums, Ripple-alphabet XRP addresses, Cardano Bech32, Solana base58, and Polkadot SS58 (blake2b-512). It reports the detected chain, address type, network and whether the embedded checksum is valid, and can auto-detect the chain from a raw address. Built for crypto exchanges, wallets, fintech KYC/withdrawal screens and payment gateways that must screen user-entered addresses before funds move.

get.summary: Validate an address (optionally for a specific chain)
get.description: Validate a crypto address. If "chain" is provided it is validated strictly against that chain; otherwise the address is matched against every supported chain and the first match is reported.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Restrict validation to one chain (BTC, LTC, DOGE, DASH, ETH, TRON, XRP, ADA, SOL, DOT)

get.summary: Detect the chain(s) an address belongs to
get.description: Auto-detect which supported chain(s) and address types an address matches, and whether the result is ambiguous.

get.summary: List supported chains, address types and algorithms
get.description: Return the list of supported chains with their address types and the validation algorithm used for each.
